text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Happy birthday! Nature, have a happy<n>birthday!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh, that was so out of sync... Though I<n>did get the
gist of what you were<n>trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okay, forget that—we also thought of a<n>little
message we wanted to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You'll be moved to tears! Ready,<n>Machitan? Here
we go...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for always looking out for us!<n>You have
Turbo's eternal gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay, this time I didn't catch any of it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But, it's the thought that counts, so...<n>Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay, now that we got that out of the<n>way...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Let's go eat some birthday cake!<n>Let's go eat
some birthday cake!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, so now you guys are in—youknow what? I'll just let it slide...
